issues.description: The template dd.py declares ComputeTable.table with an incorrect type annotation (list[tuple[DD, DD, DDOperation, DD]]) while the implementation uses it as a mapping/dictionary (self.table = {} and lookup/insert expect a dict keyed by (operand1, operand2, operation)). The solution repository uses the correct annotation (dict[tuple[DD, DD, DDOperation], DD]). This mismatch in the template's type annotation may confuse students reading the API and can trigger type checker warnings or mislead their mental model of the compute table data structure.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template dd.py type annotation for ComputeTable.table to match its usage and the solution, e.g. change it to: table: dict[tuple[DD, DD, DDOperation], DD]. Ensure the docstring/comments consistently describe the table as a dictionary mapping (operand1, operand2, operation) to the result.
